result:
Lint is clean too. The implementation is complete:

**Summary of changes:**
- `src/types/organization.ts` — added `OwnershipHandoverStatus` and `OwnershipHandover`
- `src/types/event.ts` — added `organization.ownership_transferred` to `TaskflowEventMap`
- `src/types/activity.ts` — added `organization.ownership_transferred` audit action
- `src/types/notification.ts`, `src/schemas/notification.ts`, `src/server/db/schema/notifications.ts` — added `ownership_handover` notification kind
- `src/types/permission.ts`, `src/lib/permissions.ts` — added `org:manage_ownership` action (role floor: owner)
- `src/lib/errors.ts` — added `OwnershipHandoverError`/`OwnershipHandoverRefusal`, wired into `isDomainError`/`toAppError`
- `src/server/db/schema/ownership-handovers.ts` (new) + `schema/index.ts` + `migrate.ts` — new `ownership_handovers` table
- `src/server/repositories/ownership-handover-repository.ts` (new) — insert/find-pending/resolve
- `src/server/repositories/organization-repository.ts` — added `updateOrgOwner`
- `src/server/repositories/_mappers.ts` — added `toOwnershipHandover`
- `src/server/services/organization-service.ts` — the five new exported functions, plus an `assertIsRecordedOwner` guard distinguishing "not owner-ranked" from "owner-ranked but not the recorded owner"
- `src/server/services/member-service.ts` — auto-withdraws an open handover when either side is removed
- `src/server/services/activity-service.ts` — audits `organization.ownership_transferred`
- `src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts`, `notification-preferences-form.tsx` — added labels for the new enum values (needed for `tsc --noEmit` to pass)

One correctness issue I caught and fixed during smoke-testing: `getPendingOwnershipHandover` initially persisted the lazy "expired" transition on a plain read, which could make a later `acceptOwnershipHandover`/`declineOwnershipHandover` call see `"nothing_pending"` instead of the spec-mandated `"expired"`, depending on call order. Fixed by making that getter a pure, non-mutating check — only genuine actions (initiate/accept/decline/cancel/member-removal) settle a lapsed offer into a terminal DB status.
